items.quote: and is used by four other test engineers.
items.note: The nightly Python tool used by other engineers is presented as production use, which is borderline but reads as production software.
The cover letter states the experience is 'rather than a cloud data platform' and no cloud work is listed.
The cover letter says Airflow and dbt have not been used professionally, and Spark and Kafka do not appear.
Only querying and an IT-provisioned staging table are mentioned; no data modelling or schema design.
Docker appears only as 'Followed a tutorial to run the project using Docker Compose'.
CI/CD is not mentioned in either document.
Data validation against specs is not the same as automated testing of code; no code testing is claimed.
The Flask API is a personal learning project, not a production REST API.

items.quote: including changes to setpoints and timers in Siemens TIA Portal
items.note: Changing setpoints and timers in TIA Portal on a PLC-controlled bench implies PLC programming work.
The course is listed as 'In progress' with six of nine modules completed, and no certification is claimed.

items.item: Upgrading Python/MATLAB scripts to 'production Python services' or 'built and deployed data pipelines'
items.note: Scripts are described as Python scripts and tools, not production services or deployed pipelines.

items.item: Describing the Task Scheduler script as an orchestrated ETL pipeline or adding Airflow/dbt
items.note: The Task Scheduler script is not described as an ETL pipeline and no Airflow is added.

items.note: The documents say results are written to an IT-provisioned staging table, not that he designed or administered the database.

items.note: GCP, BigQuery, CI/CD and Kafka are not listed; Docker Compose is labelled a personal learning project.

items.item: Presenting the laptop Flask API or the Docker Compose tutorial as professional backend work
items.note: The Flask API and Docker Compose work are labelled as a personal learning project, not professional work.

items.item: Calling him a PLC programmer or industrial automation engineer
items.note: He is not called a PLC programmer or automation engineer; the PLC work is described as support.

items.item: Listing the unfinished online course as a certificate
items.note: The course is listed as in progress, not as a certificate.

items.item: Retitling his current job as Data Engineer or Software Engineer, or presenting him as a senior data engineer because of 12 years of engineering
items.note: The current job title stays Test & Validation Engineer; Senior Data Engineer is only the role applied for.
